method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: S&P 500 to Test Record High in Buildup to Earnings: Markets Wrap
Equities.reason: Broad-market bullish signal heading into a major earnings season; supports risk-on narrative and possibility of indices revisiting highs. High relevance because it frames market regime and positioning ahead of earnings catalysts.

Equities.title: S&P 500 futures rise with big banks set to kick off earnings season
Equities.reason: Fresh optimism into earnings kickoff from major banks, reinforcing near-term risk-on; relevant for market breadth but more tactical than structural.

Equities.title: Tech Earnings Loom Large for Hedge Funds Packed Into Dispersion Trade
Equities.reason: Concentrated hedge fund positions into dispersion ahead of tech reports raises risk of volatility and destabilising flows if earnings disappoint; medium relevance as it targets a large, levered cohort.

Equities.title: Bank earnings to shed first light on how higher yields are affecting the economy
Equities.reason: Banks are the first post-rate-test for the economy; results could reveal cracks from higher rates or provide reassurance. Modest negative tilt reflecting uncertainty and potential downside to financials and broader sentiment.

Equities.title: Why Nvidia’s stock is dodging the AI credit scare crushing Broadcom and Oracle
Equities.reason: Reinforces market narrative of concentrated leadership — AI/semiconductor winners (Nvidia) continuing to outpace peers — supporting market breadth skew toward mega-cap tech leadership.

Equities.title: Nvidia GPUs are everywhere. Here are the ways companies are accessing them
Equities.summary: One industry researcher identified over 300 neoclouds that can provide GPU capacity, up about 55% in less than a year.
Equities.reason: Supports durable demand narrative for AI hardware and cloud capacity — positive tail for AI leaders and related hardware ecosystem; fairly high relevance to sector leadership and earnings outlook.

Equities.title: The huge lurking leverage of AI hyperscalers
Equities.summary: While equity investors look to sunny futures, creditors are scrutinising liabilities like leases on data centres
Equities.reason: Highlights creditor-side risks and hidden leverage at the centre of the AI trade; raises a medium-to-high systemic risk that could dent investor enthusiasm for leveraged hyperscalers and rebalance valuations.

Equities.title: Living with Mom and trading on margin. The regular investor gets in on Wall Street's record stock borrowing binge
Equities.summary: Margin debt has surged to record levels as investors like 29-year-old Hy Luu borrow more against their portfolios. Here’s how leverage can amplify stock losses.
Equities.reason: Record margin borrowing increases downside risk in a market already concentrated in a few names; amplifies potential drawdowns and volatility if sentiment shifts — notable negative for equity risk profile.

Equities.title: Houthi Attacks on Saudi Arabia Raise Risk of Wider War
Equities.reason: Escalating Middle East conflict increases geopolitical risk premium and could trigger risk-off flows, higher energy volatility and pressure on global equities; high relevance for market sentiment and liquidity.

Rates.title: Bond Selloff May Mean Fewer Rate Hikes From Global Central Banks
Rates.reason: Headline signals a bond selloff / rising yields narrative. Rising yields and tighter financial conditions are negative for bond prices (rates framework). Important cross-border implication (global central banks) raises relevance.

Rates.title: Minutes of the Federal Open Market Committee, September 15-16, 2026
Rates.summary: Minutes of the Federal Open Market Committee, September 15-16, 2026
Rates.reason: FOMC minutes are a high-signal rates input. The interpretation favors a higher-for-longer / sticky inflation reading in markets, which is negative for bond prices (yields up). High relevance due to direct Fed policy transmission to rates.

Rates.title: Four signs it is about to get uglier in the bond market as yields rise
Rates.reason: Title explicitly points to rising yields and deterioration in the bond market — a clear negative signal for bond prices. Relevance elevated as it outlines market indicators pointing to widening selloff.

Rates.title: Why Economists Think Higher Bond Yields Are Here to Stay
Rates.reason: Narrative that higher bond yields are persistent is explicitly negative for bond prices. Economists' consensus pieces shape medium-term rates expectations, increasing relevance.

Rates.title: Korean Bond Rally Seen Faltering as Traders Brace for Rate Hikes
Rates.reason: Regional bond-market note: local rally stalling as markets price more hikes. Negative for bond prices locally and indicative of broader higher-for-longer policy repricing in EM/DM bond markets.

Rates.title: The bull market is turning 4 years old — but yields could crash the party
Rates.reason: Headline frames rising yields as a risk to equities and the market cycle — reinforces a negative bias for bonds (higher yields = selloff) and is market-regime relevant.

Rates.title: Is 8% next? Why mortgage rates have surged, and may stay higher for longer
Rates.reason: Mortgage-rate piece underscores broader higher-rates narrative and transmission to credit markets; relevant to yield curve and rate-sensitive sectors but less direct for sovereign bond flow — therefore lower relevance.

FX.title: EUR/USD Price Forecast: Gets some relief from Russia-Ukraine energy ceasefire
FX.summary: The Euro (EUR) is marginally higher at around 1.1208 against the US Dollar (USD) during the Asian trading session on Monday. The major currency pair gets slight relief from the announcement of an energy ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine, which has put some
FX.reason: Ceasefire reduces energy risk premium and broad USD softness -> EUR/USD up. Medium relevance as this is a direct USD-pair move tied to a geopolitical catalyst.

FX.title: Forex Today: US Dollar softens amid hopes of Russia-Ukraine energy ceasefire
FX.summary: Here is what you need to know on Monday, October 12:
FX.reason: Broad USD weakness narrative driven by energy-ceasefire hopes; high relevance for FX because it frames USD direction across pairs.

FX.title: Euro holds gains above 1.1200 despite France’s bond turmoil
FX.summary: The EUR/USD pair recovers some lost ground to near 1.1215 during the early Asian trading hours on Monday. The US Dollar (USD) softens against the Euro (EUR) after weaker-than-expected US Consumer Sentiment data.
FX.reason: USD softening after weak US data supports EUR gains; relevant for EUR/USD flow but not a regime-shifting development.

FX.title: GBP/USD Price Forecast: Edges higher near 1.3250, but technical tone stays bearish below 100-day SMA
FX.summary: The GBP/USD pair trades in positive territory around 1.3240 during the early European trading hours on Monday. The US Dollar (USD) softens against the British Pound (GBP) as markets continue to assess the US Federal Reserve (Fed) rate hike path.
FX.reason: GBP benefiting from softer USD and Fed-rate-path uncertainty; useful for GBP/USD positioning but largely technical/short-term.

FX.title: Euro: Downside risks toward 1.1145 against US Dollar – UOB
FX.summary: United Overseas Bank’s (UOB) Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann report EUR/USD closed near 1.1200 after a volatile session that failed to generate fresh directional clues. For the day, they expect a 1.1180–1.1230 range.
FX.reason: Technical/near-term warning of downside for EUR/USD; low-to-medium relevance as a counter-signal to the broader USD-softness theme.

FX.title: Australian Dollar fails ahead of 0.7000 as hawkish Fed and Iran risks limit USD losses
FX.summary: The AUD/USD pair struggles to capitalize on a modest Asian session uptick, trading below the 0.7000 psychological mark and below a nearly two-week high, touched earlier this Monday.
FX.reason: AUD upside capped by hawkish Fed and geopolitical (Iran) risk -> USD resilience; medium relevance as it shows limits to the USD-softness narrative.

FX.title: Swiss Franc struggles as SNB dovish stance lifts USD/CHF
FX.summary: USD/CHF gains ground after two days of losses, trading around 0.8310 during Asian hours on Monday. The currency pair is finding upward support as the Swiss Franc (CHF) remains under pressure from short positions.
FX.reason: SNB dovishness weakening CHF and lifting USD/CHF -> points to pockets of USD strength versus safe-haven CHF; relevant for USD-breadth.

FX.title: Indian Rupee gains 1% on fresh RBI measures at start of the week
FX.summary: The Indian Rupee (INR) opens significantly higher against the US Dollar (USD) on Monday. The USD/INR pair falls 1% to near 95.80 as Reserve Bank of India’s (RBI) fresh measures to curb US Dollar demand has brought relief for the Indian currency.
FX.reason: Direct, large policy-driven intervention/restrictions from RBI reduced USD demand and triggered ~1% INR jump — high relevance for EM FX and USD flows.

FX.title: India steps up currency defense with tougher US Dollar curbs — Reuters
FX.summary: India unveiled a new measures to boost the Indian Rupee (INR), redirecting oil companies' US Dollar purchases ‌away from the spot market and tightening hedging rules, Reuters reported on Saturday. The move comes as the domestic currency trades near record lows
FX.reason: Authoritative report of policy measures redirecting USD demand — significant for INR and broader EM FX liquidity; strong relevance.

FX.title: USD/CAD Price Forecast: US Dollar eases within range in a quiet session
FX.summary: The US Dollar (USD) has opened the week with a mild bearish tone against the Canadian Dollar (CAD), with trading volumes at low levels as the Japanese markets are closed on bank holidays and with the US and Canada also celebrating festivities.
FX.reason: Mild USD easing vs CAD in quiet conditions; limited relevance but reflects CAD sensitivity to USD moves and calendar liquidity.

FX.title: Canadian Dollar flat lines around 1.4250 as sliding oil prices counter USD softness
FX.summary: The USD/CAD pair struggles to capitalize on a modest gap-up open at the start of a new week, retreating back to mid-1.4200s during the Asian session.
FX.reason: CAD movement tempered by oil weakness offsetting USD softness — small net impact on CAD in near term.

FX.title: New Zealand Dollar weakens as Middle East conflict elevates inflation risks
FX.summary: NZD/USD remains subdued for the second successive day, trading around 0.5610 during Asian hours on Monday.
FX.reason: Geopolitical-driven risk/inflation fears weighing on NZD vs USD; relevant for NZD and risk-sensitive FX pairs.

FX.title: Japanese Yen holds range amid Japanese holiday, dovish BoJ signals
FX.summary: USD/JPY depreciates after registering modest gains in the previous trading day, hovering around 158.10 during Asian hours on Monday. The pair may see limited movement due to thin trading conditions as Japanese markets are closed for the Sports Day public holid
FX.reason: JPY showing strength in thin conditions despite dovish BoJ signals — relevant because JPY moves and intervention talk can have outsized market impact.

FX.title: EUR/JPY Price Forecast: Rises to near 177.50 barrier near nine-day EMA
FX.summary: EUR/JPY gains ground for the third successive day, trading around 177.40 during Asian hours on Monday. Liquidity would be thin, although it is the best opportunity for 'Yentervention'.
FX.reason: EUR/JPY rally implies JPY weakness and raises intervention risk ('Yentervention'). Non-USD cross but high relevance due to potential BoJ/authorities reaction.

Commodities.title: Gold drifts higher above $4,200 on surging ETF inflows, markets await US inflation data this week
Commodities.summary: Gold price (XAU/USD) gains ground to near $4,215 during the early Asian session on Monday. The precious metal extends the rally amid rising demand for bullion-backed exchange-traded funds and a weaker US Dollar (USD).
Commodities.reason: Bullion ETF inflows and weaker USD are direct demand drivers for gold prices; meaningful for precious metals market sentiment.

Commodities.title: Gold gains on weaker oil, dollar; US inflation data in focus
Commodities.reason: Reuters piece likely reflects cross-asset drivers (weaker oil and USD, macro data focus) that lift safe-haven gold; material market signal from a major newswire.

Commodities.title: Why China is importing a record amount of gold — and what it means for prices
Commodities.summary: Beijing’s push to diversify away from the dollar and Chinese households’ search for a safe place to put their savings has fueled China’s record gold buying.
Commodities.reason: Large-scale Chinese official/reserve and retail demand is a major structural support to gold prices and materially increases relevance for the gold market.

Commodities.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD holds gains near $61 amid Russia-Ukraine ceasefire
Commodities.summary: Silver price (XAG/USD) trades higher at around $61.10 in the Asian trade on Monday, holding onto Friday’s gains.
Commodities.reason: Silver holding gains is relevant to precious metals flows but is a narrower market signal than gold; linked to geopolitical ceasefire developments.

Commodities.title: Brent: Houthi escalation keeps risk premium elevated – Commerzbank
Commodities.summary: Commerzbank strategists note that Brent Oil remains above USD 100 as markets weigh heightened geopolitical risk from Houthi attacks on Saudi infrastructure.
Commodities.reason: Persistent geopolitical attacks in the Middle East raise the oil risk premium and support higher Brent — a clear supply-risk driven bullish impulse for crude.

Commodities.title: Oil climbs as Mideast conflict, tanker attacks persist
Commodities.reason: Reuters confirms ongoing Mideast conflict and tanker attacks are lifting crude — reinforces the dominant supply-risk narrative supporting oil prices.

Commodities.title: Oil prices volatile after Trump claims ‘energy ceasefire’ in Ukraine war
Commodities.summary: Announcement follows diesel deal with Putin as US president tries to contain impact of higher fuel costs ahead of election
Commodities.reason: Claims of an 'energy ceasefire' (Russia-Ukraine) reduce the elevated geopolitical risk premium and introduce downside/volatility for oil — material but uncertain impact.

Commodities.title: Oil chiefs pull out of Riyadh energy congress after airport missile strike
Commodities.summary: BP and others skip World Petroleum Council meeting after 12 killed in Houthi attack
Commodities.reason: High-profile industry pullouts after attacks underscore supply/disruption risk and sustain a bullish price backdrop for oil.

Commodities.title: Category 2 Hurricane Isaias nears landfall, leading to production shut-ins
Commodities.summary: As of 4:00 a.m. central time on October 9, the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration expects Hurricane Isaias to make landfall on the Gulf Coast late Friday or early Saturday, creating the potential for significant disruptions to energy infrastructur
Commodities.reason: Gulf production/refinery shut-ins from a hurricane are a direct short-term supply shock for crude and refined products — supportive for prices.

Commodities.title: Crude oil prices and refinery margins generally increased throughout the third quarter
Commodities.summary: Petroleum markets in the third quarter of 2026 (3Q26) were characterized by increasing prices for crude oil and petroleum products amid persistent conflict in the Middle East.
Commodities.reason: EIA data showing higher Q3 crude prices and margins corroborates the ongoing tightness/supply-risk environment supporting oil.

Commodities.title: U.S. natural gas production reached a record high in July 2026
Commodities.summary: U.S. natural gas production hit an all-time high in July 2026, driven primarily by increased output in the Permian Basin, according to our latest Natural Gas Monthly.
Commodities.reason: Record U.S. gas output increases supply and weighs on natural gas prices — a clear negative fundamental for the gas market.

Commodities.title: Mixed outlook for energy expenditures this winter
Commodities.summary: We expect energy expenditures this winter to vary because of diverging trends in energy prices among fuels and regional variation in forecast temperatures. We expect that lower prices for natural gas and propane will drive decreases in expenditures this year f
Commodities.reason: EIA outlook notes lower expected natural gas/propane costs in parts of the US, a modest negative headwind for gas/propane prices; mixed regional effects reduce relevance.

Commodities.title: The world needs Ukraine’s grain. Its farmers are running out of reasons to plant
Commodities.summary: Cash-strapped farmers have no incentive to sow for 2027 with exports remaining trapped, as analysts say commodity markets could "flip fast."
Commodities.reason: Significant disruption to Ukrainian planting/export capacity increases global grain supply risk (wheat/corn) and is a bullish structural signal for agricultural commodities.

Commodities.title: Tokenized commodities look beyond gold as lending and oil open new markets
Commodities.reason: Tokenization and lending markets around physical commodities could incrementally improve liquidity/participation (small positive structural development) but is peripheral to spot fundamentals.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin shrugs off ETF outflows to trade above $84,000 as oil falls
Crypto.reason: Price resilience above $84k despite ETF outflows signals continued demand and liquidity for BTC; reinforces bullish institutional/ETF adoption narrative and market resilience.

Crypto.title: One year after 10/10 flash crash, bitcoin and ether liquidity have rebuilt, but altcoins still face risks
Crypto.reason: Rebuilt BTC/ETH liquidity reduces systemic tail-risk and supports market stability; altcoin fragility remains a downside but primary-repo liquidity recovery is bullish for major crypto.

Crypto.title: New York AG secures up to $35 million and lifetime crypto ban from Celsius’ Alex Mashinsky
Crypto.reason: High-profile enforcement action increases legal/regulatory risk and dampens confidence in centralized crypto platforms; negative for sector sentiment and institutional exposure.

Crypto.title: Thailand opens door to locally listed bitcoin and ether ETFs
Crypto.reason: Regulatory green-light for local BTC/ETH ETFs expands access and supports longer-term institutional and retail demand in APAC; adoption tailwind for major crypto.

Crypto.title: FTX’s Old Bitcoin-Mining Assets Are Now Part of the AI Boom
Crypto.reason: Repurposing mining assets into AI/data-centre use indicates capital redeployment rather than distressed selling of mining infrastructure; modestly positive for mining-sector balance and reduced forced-liquidation risk.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin's volatility has plunged, but extreme price swings are more frequent than in 2018
Crypto.reason: Lower baseline volatility suggests maturing market structure (positive), but persistence of extreme intraday swings implies episodic liquidity risk; overall mildly constructive for pricing and risk-taking.

Crypto.title: U.S. CFTC moves to fold event contracts into swaps regulations as legal fight rages
Crypto.reason: Regulatory tightening that brings event contracts under swaps rules raises compliance costs and uncertainty for prediction markets and derivatives platforms; negative for associated trading volumes and innovation in that niche.

Crypto.title: Ledger investigates potential wallet tampering after reports of $86 million in crypto stolen
Crypto.reason: Large reported theft / wallet tampering undermines hardware-wallet trust and broader custody confidence, likely to weigh on retail/institutional sentiment and flows until resolved.

Crypto.title: UK slaps sanctions on three crypto exchanges over alleged Russia links
Crypto.reason: Sanctions on exchanges escalate geopolitical and compliance risks for on‑ramps and could disrupt flows and counterparty relationships; negative for sector access and liquidity in affected jurisdictions.

Crypto.title: MARA transfers $81.1 million in bitcoin to Galaxy Digital as strategy pivots to AI
Crypto.reason: Miner transferring BTC to a custodian amid a strategic pivot could indicate selling or reduced on‑balance‑sheet BTC exposure from miners; modest negative for supply-side dynamics.

Crypto.title: XRP Ledger patched decade-old bug that could create billions of dollars in XRP from nothing
Crypto.reason: A critical long‑standing bug patched improves protocol security and integrity for XRP, a small positive for trust in that ledger though limited market-wide impact.
